question: What was NVIDIA's total revenue for fiscal 2026, in USD millions, and how much did it grow vs fiscal 2025?
grading: ±0.5% on revenue, USD millions; period must be FY ended 2026-01-25; growth ±0.5pp; fail if any CY2026 or FY2027 quarter used
answer: NVIDIA FY2026 revenue was USD 215,938 million, versus USD 130,497 million in FY2025: growth of 65.4735% (65% as rounded in the filing). [G01-E1]

output.answer:
**NVIDIA fiscal 2026 (ended January 25, 2026):**

- **Total revenue: $215,938 million (~$215.9B)**
- **Fiscal 2025 revenue: $130,497 million (~$130.5B)**
- **Growth: +65% year over year** (an increase of ~$85,441 million, or ~$85.4B)

For context, Q4 FY26 alone was a record $68,127 million, up 73% year over year, with Data Center revenue of $62.3B (+75% Y/Y).

Sources:
- [NVIDIA Newsroom — Q4 and Fiscal 2026 results](http://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-2026)
- [NVIDIA Q4 FY26 CFO Commentary (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000019/q4fy26cfocommentary.htm)
- [CNBC — Nvidia Q4 2026 earnings](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/25/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q4-2026.html)
